scope: Independent publication audit of current README, rankings, METHODS, Chinese research guide, structured curation and exported evidence. Targeted primary-source rechecks; not a re-review of all 479 entries.

findings.claim: CHS and AGES Neuro relevance=4; cohort-level followup is also counted as a task label and a quality point. This produces scientific ranks 2 and 3 for AGES and CHS, respectively.
findings.evidence: AGES cited eye–cognition/dementia analysis explicitly describes a cross-sectional design with 3,906 participants. CHS cited eye–cognition/dementia report explicitly concludes a cross-sectional association (2,211 retinal participants). The project rubric assigns R=3 to cognitive tests/case-control evidence and reserves the relevant R=4 example for longitudinal dementia. AGES followup is sourced to serial MRI, and CHS followup to general clinical-event surveillance; neither establishes prospective neurodegenerative outcome followup in the cited scored analysis. ranking.py/verify.py use any resource-level Confirmed followup for Q, even if a task-specific omission excludes it from L.
findings.proposed_fix: Set only these two Neuro relevance values to 3 and name their endpoints as cross-sectional. Add Neuro followup omissions for these resources; apply the same task-specific omission to the Q followup point in both ranking.py and the independent verifier. Keep the overall phenotype followup Confirmed because other directions have legitimate followup. Regenerate outputs and update the front-page Neuro recommendations. Expected scores before rank recomputation: AGES 92.5→76.25 (R4→3 and L4→3); CHS 91.25→81.25 (R4→3; L and capped Q unchanged).

findings.claim: ARIC and CHS commercial_terms export as Unknown; CHS research_terms omits consent-based research-area restrictions.
findings.evidence: The live official ARIC BioLINCC Consent section explicitly prohibits commercial use. The CHS Consent section explicitly records commercial restrictions and tiers data/biospecimen use into CVD-related research only versus unrestricted research area, with participant-specific consent options. These facts are directly relevant to selecting a neurodegeneration or commercial project; a generic RMDA/registration statement does not preserve the restrictions.
findings.proposed_fix: Add ARIC commercial_terms='Not permitted under the BioLINCC study data terms.' Add CHS commercial_terms requiring participant-consent/approved-subset verification rather than blanket permission, and extend CHS research_terms with CVD-only versus unrestricted-area consent tiers. Add narrowly scoped dated official-policy evidence entries; do not change whole-resource review dates.

verified_without_material_error.evidence: Recounted current curation and rankings: 49 reviewed = 43 included + 6 excluded; 42 ranked = 43 included minus Tsukazaki, which is G-only auxiliary. 83 resource-task pairs and 9 near-term pairs match exports. No independent-cohort claim inferred.

Live official page, last updated 2026-10-22, still states applications paused, priority restoration for compliant ongoing projects, intended late-2026 reopening. X=0 and absence from near-term list remain supported.

Descriptor Data sharing section documents access via sponsor partnership; later official news limits actual access to approved SCONe team members while broader access is being developed. Existing card appropriately states partnership, Safe Haven and no raw export; not interpreted as an open external application portal. Table 2 coded cases, not adjudicated onset, are described accurately.

Official pages verify acquired imaging and clinical/derived data paths, not an externally provisioned retinal-image manifest. Existing pixel-gate T2 judgements preserve this distinction. NHANES grading tables are not CNN image files.

verified_without_material_error.claim: AREDS2 v3 image release, mapping and MRI scope
verified_without_material_error.evidence: Downloaded public release-notes PDF and Subject_Image/SAD XML anew. 2026-10-09 v3 explicitly includes images; Subject_Image maps SUBJECT_ID+FILENAME to ocular DICOM. Subject-profile counts 1,814 male+2,387 female=4,201; 512,713 distinct filenames include annotated/migrated variants. SAD MRI variables are obtained/result/laterality summaries, not raw brain image files. Current guide preserves these distinctions and leaves endpoint intersection Unknown.

Official descriptions support TREND2 AD/chronic-disease image scope, functional OCT EOAD 14+14 design, and Harvard image/age metadata. Current guide warns about small independent N, unknown TREND2 patient count, age ranges and source-family overlap. No new dataset-wide completeness assertion was made.
